# GridStack 13.2.0

Vendored from the official npm release:
https://registry.npmjs.org/gridstack/-/gridstack-13.2.0.tgz

Upstream: https://github.com/gridstack/gridstack.js/tree/v13.2.0

Files are copied unchanged from the package: `dist/gridstack-all.js`,
`dist/gridstack.min.css`, `dist/gridstack-all.js.LICENSE.txt`, and `LICENSE`.
The original source-map references are retained; source maps are not shipped.
GridStack is MIT licensed; see the included license and bundle notice.

GryphDash embeds these assets. There is no runtime CDN or npm dependency.
